summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing of Revenge Arc landing site, waitlist, creator program, and admin console. 19/19 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend landing loads, both forms submit successfully, admin auth + 4 tabs (overview, waitlist, creators, broadcast) + approve flow all work.

minor.issue: When Resend API key is configured but rejects unverified recipients (test mode), each waitlist email counts as 'failed' instead of 'sent'. Behaviour is acceptable for the test mode, but in dashboard toast 'Sent to 0 of N (failed: N)' may confuse admin until production sender domain is verified. Consider clarifying in UI.

issues: Page order: Creator Program section is rendered before the Waitlist section. Verify this matches the intended product narrative (problem statement implied Waitlist before Creator). If not, swap order in Landing.jsx.
Wrong password shows toast but no inline error under the input — minor UX nitpick, not a bug.

action_items: Confirm whether Creator section should appear before or after Waitlist section in Landing.jsx — current order puts Creator first.
(Optional) Surface 'failed' broadcast count clearly in the Broadcast tab UI when Resend test-mode rejects unverified recipients.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend stores waitlist emails as lowercase but does NOT lowercase incoming creator emails in the duplicate check (creator-applications has no duplicate guard at all — duplicate creator applications can be submitted unlimited times). Recommend adding a uniqueness constraint or 409 like waitlist if business requires it.

ADMIN_TOKEN is a static long-lived token returned by /api/admin/login with no expiry/rotation. Acceptable for an MVP single-admin system, but flag for future hardening (JWT with exp, refresh, rate limiting on /admin/login).

send_email_async catches all exceptions and returns None — broadcast 'failed' counter relies on this. Good. But individual waitlist/creator endpoints don't surface email failures to caller (best-effort). Consistent with spec.
/api/admin/announce iterates synchronously via await per recipient — for 50k waitlist members it will be slow. Consider batching/concurrency (asyncio.gather with semaphore) when list grows.
All MongoDB queries correctly project out _id. No ObjectId leakage detected.
All env vars sourced from .env, no hardcoded URLs/credentials. ✅
data-testid attributes well-distributed across interactive elements. ✅
seed_data_creation: Tests created multiple TEST_-prefixed waitlist entries and creator applications to validate flows. Admin approve was triggered on one application during UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_revenge_arc_api.py covers all 19 endpoints and is reusable as regression suite. UI flows verified: landing, waitlist submit, creator validation + submit, admin login (wrong+correct), all 4 admin tabs, approve, logout. Resend in test mode may report broadcast 'sent' as failed for unverified recipients — that is expected behaviour, not a bug. Use unique TEST_-prefixed emails to avoid 409 collisions on waitlist.
